name: europe

frame.formula: (X, Y) = Equal Earth(lon, lat); keep X, -Y inside rect; x = (X - cx) * s, z = (-Y - cz) * s

source: Natural Earth 1:50m admin-0 countries v4.1 (public domain) via world-atlas 2.0.2 countries-50m (https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas), Equal Earth projection
orientation: rings not closed; outer rings counter-clockwise seen from +Y with north (-Z) up, i.e. positive shoelace area in (x, -z); holes clockwise
notes: Crop of the Natural Earth world map (Equal Earth, lon0 = 0) to a rectangle spanning lon -25..45 at lat 50 and lat 34..71.5 at lon 10; every country with land in the rectangle, clipped.
